For a!=0, an unsafe full tail forces 5(1-s)<=2r(x+r/2); after a two-variable completion of squares this caps its harmonic score by 2/31. This removes the conjectural radial-crossing bridge and proves the complete closed-disk primitive sparse quintic theorem, including mixed root configurations.
